selected_evidence.requirement: usb-storage module blocked from loading now (both blacklist and explicit modprobe)
selected_evidence.summary: After writing the blacklist/install config, 'modprobe usb-storage' failed with an error and lsmod confirmed the module was not loaded.

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistence across reboot (configuration baked into initramfs and surviving restart)
selected_evidence.summary: dracut regeneration bundled /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf into the initramfs; after reboot the file still exists, modprobe is still blocked, and modprobe --showconfig shows the blacklist/install rules for usb_storage active.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 6aa805ba... captured pre-restart; systemctl reboot acknowledged in background; node1 became unreachable then reachable again with new boot_id 15ba9cd1..., proving an actual restart; post-restart checks confirm usb-storage still blocked/unloaded and config persisted.

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== boot id baseline =="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo "== os release =="
cat /etc/os-release | head -5
echo "== usb-storage loaded? =="
lsmod | grep -i usb_storage || echo "not currently loaded"
echo "== existing blacklist files =="
ls -la /etc/modprobe.d/ 2>/dev/null || true
grep -rl usb-storage /etc/modprobe.d/ 2>/dev/null || echo "no existing blacklist entry"
echo "== dracut/initramfs tool check =="
command -v dracut || true
command -v update-initramfs || true

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== step: write blacklist config =="
sudo -n tee /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf > /dev/null <<'EOF'
blacklist usb-storage
install usb-storage /bin/false
EOF
cat /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf

echo "== step: try to load module (should be blocked) =="
sudo -n modprobe usb-storage && echo "UNEXPECTED: module loaded" || echo "OK: modprobe blocked as expected"

echo "== step: verify not loaded =="
lsmod | grep -i usb_storage || echo "confirmed: not loaded"

echo "== step: rebuild initramfs for persistence =="
sudo -n dracut -f --regenerate-all
echo "dracut exit: $?"

echo "== step: verify module absent from initramfs config =="
sudo -n lsinitrd | grep -i "usb-storage" || echo "usb-storage not bundled/loaded by initramfs config"
zcat /boot/initramfs-$(uname -r).img 2>/dev/null | cpio -it 2>/dev/null | grep -i "modprobe.d" | head -5 || true
echo "== done =="

echo "== modprobe config resolution =="
sudo -n modprobe --showconfig | grep -i usb-storage
